rules.name: legacy-views-vs-pg-tables
rules.sql: SELECT table_name AS legacy_view, CASE WHEN table_name REGEXP '_(alm|bkr|cfs|coc|cof|cto|ebo|grn|gpc|og2|ogp|orm|osg|pf6|pf9|pg7|pg8|qf1|qf2|qf3|qf4|qf5|rba|rbc|rbh|rmc|rov|stg|tsy|usg|pmc|agf)$' THEN SUBSTRING(table_name, 1, CHAR_LENGTH(table_name) - 4) ELSE table_name END AS base_name FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_schema = 'dbsystemuat' ORDER BY table_name

SELECT c.relname AS pg_name, CASE c.relkind WHEN 'r' THEN 'TABLE' WHEN 'p' THEN 'TABLE' WHEN 'v' THEN 'view' WHEN 'm' THEN 'matview' END AS pg_kind, CASE WHEN c.relkind IN ('r', 'p') THEN (xpath('/row/c/text()', query_to_xml(format('select count(*) as c from %I.%I', n.nspname, c.relname), false, true, '')))[1]::text::bigint END AS exact_rows, s.n_tup_ins AS inserts_since_stats_reset, s.n_tup_upd AS updates_since_stats_reset, s.last_autoanalyze FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_stat_user_tables s ON s.relid = c.oid WHERE n.nspname = 'opera' AND c.relkind IN ('r', 'p', 'v', 'm') AND (CASE WHEN c.relname ~ '_(alm|bkr|cfs|coc|cof|cto|ebo|grn|gpc|og2|ogp|orm|osg|pf6|pf9|pg7|pg8|qf1|qf2|qf3|qf4|qf5|rba|rbc|rbh|rmc|rov|stg|tsy|usg|pmc|agf)$' THEN left(c.relname, length(c.relname) - 4) ELSE c.relname END) IN (:v.base_name[]) ORDER BY 2 DESC, 3 NULLS LAST, 1

expect.reason: the legacy schema must hold views
PG objects that share a name with a legacy view; read them, the tool cannot judge them
